f70fcd61267e37d9.description: About the Role Nesma Infrastructure & Technology is seeking a Learning and Development Lead to join their team in Makkah, with operations extending to Jeddah. This full-time role focuses on designing, implementing, and continuously enhancing the organization’s learning and development strategy. The objective is to align L&D initiatives with business objectives, build organizational capability, improve employee performance, and foster a culture of continuous learning. Role Purpose The Learning and Development Lead will be responsible for driving talent development through structured programs, strategic initiatives, and modern learning solutions. This includes ensuring that all learning activities contribute directly to the company's strategic goals and support the growth of its workforce. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute the annual Learning & Development (L&D) strategy in alignment with organizational goals and workforce planning. Conduct training needs analysis (TNA) across departments to identify skill gaps and development priorities. Design, implement, and evaluate training programs, including leadership development, technical training, and soft skills. Manage end-to-end learning programs, covering planning, vendor coordination, delivery, and post-training evaluation. Lead onboarding and induction programs to ensure smooth employee integration into the company. Establish competency frameworks and career development pathways for employees. Support performance management processes by linking development plans to performance outcomes. Introduce and manage digital learning platforms, such as Learning Management Systems (LMS), e-learning modules, and microlearning tools. Measure training effectiveness using key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Return on Investment (ROI), engagement levels, and performance improvement metrics. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in learning and development roles, demonstrating a strong background in strategy design and program implementation. Work Location This position is based in Makkah, with responsibilities extending to Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. Application Process The salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

f726bf978b93a57e.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Director - Organizational Development to provide enterprise-wide leadership in organizational design, workforce planning, and OD foundations across the group and its subsidiaries. This full-time role ensures that organizational structures, roles, governance, and workforce capacity align with business priorities, capital programs, and long-term growth ambitions. The Director will own the organization’s OD frameworks, job architecture, grading standards, and job evaluation governance to ensure internal equity, role clarity, scalability, and operating effectiveness. Key Responsibilities Lead the design and continuous evolution of enterprise and functional target operating models (TOMs) aligned with strategy and growth plans. Establish and govern organizational design frameworks, principles, and standards for scalability and accountability. Sponsor major restructuring, transformation, and capability-led design initiatives across corporate, business, and development functions. Oversee the design of organization structures, reporting lines, role charters, and governance forums. Lead the setup of OD foundations for new subsidiaries and group entities, including structure, grading architecture, and job frameworks. Ensure consistent application of group-wide OD standards while allowing for contextual flexibility across entities. Oversee analysis of spans of control, workforce layering, and reporting lines to optimize leadership bandwidth and cost-effectiveness. Own the enterprise workforce planning framework and annual/multi-year planning cycles in partnership with HRBPs and Finance. Govern enterprise job architecture, grading standards, and job evaluation methodologies, ensuring equity and internal consistency. Act as a strategic advisor to senior leadership and HR on organizational effectiveness and structural design. Lead, mentor, and develop the Organizational Development team, building OD capability and knowledge assets. Organizational Development Leadership As a strategic advisor to senior leadership and HR, the Director will partner closely with Strategy, Finance, HRBPs, and business leaders to integrate workforce and organizational considerations into enterprise strategy, transformation programs, and growth initiatives. The role contributes to target operating model (TOM) development initiatives and builds the Organizational Development function, setting delivery standards, governance processes, and quality controls. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 12 years of experience in Organizational Development, Operating Model Design, or Strategic HR roles. Proven experience in target operating model (TOM) design and enterprise transformation. Hands-on experience in setting up OD foundations for new subsidiaries or business entities. Experience working in group company environments with multiple subsidiaries. Strong background in strategic workforce planning, organizational design, and job evaluation. Executive-level stakeholder engagement and governance leadership experience. Exposure to or experience within development-sector organizations is strongly preferred. Work Environment This is a full-time position within Qiddiya Investment Company, focusing on enterprise-wide organizational development initiatives. The role involves collaboration with various departments and senior leadership to drive strategic alignment and operational effectiveness across the group and its subsidiaries.

f7a510157cbdfc83.description: About the Role Adidas is seeking a Store Manager to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah. This full-time position is designed for individuals with 0-1 years of experience, focusing on driving store sales and contributing to the overall profitability of the company. The role emphasizes consumer engagement, operational excellence, and fostering a consumer-centric culture within the store. Purpose and Impact The Store Manager contributes to the store's sales and Adidas' profit targets by inspiring and serving consumers, diligently executing store operations, and fostering a consumer-centric culture. This role is integral to enhancing the consumer experience and maintaining brand standards. Key Responsibilities Engage actively with consumers and contribute to store sales by being aware of store KPIs. Improve the consumer experience by implementing CONNECT-ENGAGE-INSPIRE service standards. Act as a Brand advocate, consistently demonstrating the company's 6 Values. Utilize seasonal product and Brand knowledge during consumer interactions to communicate features, benefits, and unique selling points. Connect consumers to relevant digital and omnichannel tools for a seamless shopping experience, guiding them through in-store digital touchpoints. Process merchandise deliveries efficiently and replenish fixtures to ensure full product representation on the sales floor. Complete sales transactions accurately and quickly, adhering to cash protection procedures and maximizing add-on sales at the cash desk. Minimize loss in both the stockroom and sales floor. Perform all store operations safely, effectively, and efficiently, complying with operational policies and procedures. Maintain an appealing and easy-to-shop environment by executing visual merchandising and housekeeping standards. Contribute to maximizing sales and minimizing loss, staying informed about competitors. Offer suggestions for improving operations and processes. Collaborate productively and respectfully with team members, fostering an inclusive environment. Seek and apply coaching and learning opportunities to continually improve personal and store performance. Key Relationships This role involves direct interaction with consumers, as well as collaboration with peers and supervisors to ensure smooth store operations and a positive shopping experience. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of relevant experience. Ability to actively engage with consumers and contribute to sales targets. Understanding of store KPIs and how individual contributions impact them. Commitment to continuous learning and professional development. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah. The role requires a team-first mindset and active contribution to an inclusive and welcoming environment for all colleagues and consumers.

f7a89a88da8a6a84.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مصنع أقوات للصناعات الغذائية عن فني صيانة ميكانيكية للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ضمان الأداء الفعال للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية من خلال تشخيص الأعطال وتنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تتبع المخططات الميكانيكية للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية لتحديد إجراءات تشخيص الأعطال. تشخيص أعطال المنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية، وتقدير كمية وتكلفة مواد ومستلزمات الصيانة ومتابعة توفيرها. متابعة إجراءات إصلاح الأعطال وفحص الأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية بعد الإصلاح للتأكد من دقة أدائها وضبطها. متابعة تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية وفقاً للخطط المحددة. إعداد تقارير العمل وتقديمها وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال صيانة ميكانيكية مماثل. القدرة على قراءة وتتبع المخططات الميكانيكية. مهارات تشخيص الأعطال الميكانيكية وتحديد أسبابها. القدرة على تقدير كمية وتكلفة المواد والمستلزمات اللازمة للصيانة. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الصيانة الميكانيكية ضمن فريق في مصنع أقوات للصناعات الغذائية في مكة المكرمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام ببرامج الصيانة الوقائية والتصحيحية لضمان استمرارية العمليات التشغيلية. نطاق المسؤولية يشمل نطاق المسؤولية متابعة الأداء الميكانيكي للمعدات، وضمان دقة الإصلاحات، والالتزام بجدول الصيانة الوقائية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير الدورية عن حالة العمليات. معلومات إضافية المنطقة: مكة المكرمة. نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه.

f7eac87565fc311e.description: About Hala Hala is seeking a Digital Marketing Manager to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position focused on driving customer and merchant growth across payment products and services through digital marketing and performance acquisition activities. Role Overview The Digital Marketing Manager will lead Hala's digital marketing and performance acquisition efforts. This role involves owning the digital channel strategy, campaign performance, acquisition funnels, and budget optimization to maximize conversion, ROI, and sustainable growth for the company. Key Responsibilities Develop and lead the digital marketing and paid acquisition strategy across SEM, paid social, display, and other relevant channels. Manage digital acquisition performance across the funnel, from awareness and lead generation through conversion and activation. Oversee digital marketing budgets and optimize channel allocation based on Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), conversion, Return on Investment (ROI), and business performance. Lead campaign planning, audience targeting, retargeting, and A/B testing to continuously improve performance. Collaborate with Product, Creative, and Technology teams to optimize landing pages and conversion funnels. Establish and monitor digital marketing Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), attribution, dashboards, and performance reporting. Partner with Product, Sales, Data, Creative, Marketing Operations, and Compliance teams to support product launches and growth initiatives. Identify new digital channels, technologies, and growth opportunities relevant to Hala’s customer and merchant segments. Ensure digital campaigns comply with Hala’s brand standards, internal policies, and applicable KSA regulatory requirements. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in digital marketing and performance acquisition. Work Environment and Location This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a dynamic team focused on driving growth in the payment products and services sector.

f70410c3643cc422.description: About the Role ITCAN TECHNOLOGY and DIGITAL MARKETING is seeking an Influencer Communication Executive to join their team in Dammam, Eastern Province. This full-time role focuses on managing the full lifecycle of influencer bookings, from initial confirmation to the live execution of campaigns. The ideal candidate will have 0-1 years of experience in a related field and will be responsible for ensuring timely and accurate delivery of influencer advertisements. Key Responsibilities Manage ad bookings by contacting planned influencers, negotiating rates, confirming dates, sending scripts, and following up to ensure ads go live on schedule. Handle payments and invoicing, including creating contracts and invoices, requesting payments, sharing transfer receipts, and tracking paid ads against completed ads. Maintain current client plans by updating rates, booking statuses, and completed ads, and flagging any rate or date changes to planners. Monitor ad quality and provide feedback to influencers to ensure content aligns with the client brief. Coordinate with recording freelancers and the PAM team, and keep trackers and ad cards updated. Qualifications and Experience Based in the Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia. Fluent in both English and Arabic, written and spoken, with the ability to negotiate with influencers and communicate with clients and internal teams in both languages. 1-2 years of experience in influencer marketing, campaign operations, or a similar role. Proven negotiation skills, with experience agreeing on rates, dates, and deliverables with influencers or their managers. Experience handling contracts, invoices, and payment follow-ups, with strong attention to detail regarding figures and deadlines. Required Skills Highly organized, capable of managing multiple bookings at different stages and maintaining accurate trackers. Confident and professional communicator, able to build relationships with influencers and provide clear, constructive feedback. Ability to interpret client briefs and assess content alignment. Possesses an ownership mindset, following bookings through to go-live and proactively flagging risks such as rate or date changes.

f74dc78e8b53afcb.description: About the Role ABIS is seeking an Electrical (SMP) professional to join its team. This full-time role involves the installation, inspection, maintenance, and troubleshooting of electrical equipment and systems within Oil & Gas, petrochemical, and power plant facilities. The position requires a minimum of 10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on electrical systems to ensure safe and reliable operations. Inspect, test, and troubleshoot electrical transformers, switchgear, circuit breakers, and motor control centers (MCC). Support the installation, testing, and commissioning of electrical substations and associated equipment. Perform testing and maintenance of protection relays and electrical distribution systems. Troubleshoot and maintain Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) systems, Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC), and motor starters. Inspect and maintain Low Voltage (LV), Medium Voltage (MV), and High Voltage (HV) electrical equipment. Perform electrical testing, including insulation resistance testing, Megger testing, and HIPOT testing. Inspect, troubleshoot, and maintain power generators, Automatic Transfer Switches (ATS), and MOV actuators. Use electrical testing equipment to identify faults and verify equipment performance. Ensure compliance with electrical safety procedures, hazard recognition practices, and applicable NEC standards. Prepare maintenance reports, document inspection findings, and maintain accurate technical records. Coordinate with maintenance and engineering teams to resolve electrical issues and minimize equipment downtime. Qualifications and Experience Education: For local and expat candidates with a degree: Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a Bachelor's degree in a Technical, Trade, or Vocational field specializing in Electrical Engineering or Electrical Technology. For expat candidates without a degree: High School Certificate or Vocational School Diploma in Electrical Technology or a related field. Experience: For candidates with a degree: Minimum 4 years of relevant experience in the Oil & Gas sector. For candidates without a degree: Minimum 11 years of relevant experience in the Oil & Gas sector. English Language Proficiency: Minimum IELTS score of or equivalent TOEFL scores (Internet-Based (iBT): 60, Paper-Based (PBT): 498, Computer-Based (CBT): 171). Preferred Technical Skills Experience in Oil & Gas, petrochemical, or power plant environments. Strong knowledge of electrical equipment troubleshooting and maintenance. Experience with transformers, LV/HV switchgear, and electrical substations. Knowledge of substation commissioning and protection relay systems. Experience with UPS, PLC, motor starters, and Motor Control Centers (MCC). Familiarity with circuit breakers, MOV actuators, and power generators. Knowledge of LV, MV, and HV electrical distribution systems. Experience with electrical testing equipment, including Megger and insulation resistance testing. Knowledge of HIPOT testing and electrical protection systems. Familiarity with Automatic Transfer Switches (ATS) and FVD systems. Understanding of electrical hazard recognition, electrical safety procedures, and NEC standards. Work Type This is a full-time position.

f7a958e95b4679d2.description: Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Platform Engineer to design, build, maintain, and continuously improve scalable and reliable platform infrastructure that enables development teams to deliver software efficiently. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, containerization, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation, and CI/CD technologies. The role focuses on building internal developer platforms, automating infrastructure provisioning, improving developer experience, and ensuring platform scalability, security, and reliability across enterprise environments. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain scalable platform engineering solutions to support software development and deployment. Develop and manage Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs) to improve developer productivity and experience. Build, maintain, and optimize Kubernetes clusters and containerized environments. Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation. Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration management using Infrastructure as Code (IaC). Manage cloud infrastructure across AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. Develop reusable platform components, templates, and self-service tools for development teams. Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability solutions. Ensure platform availability, scalability, performance, and reliability. Collaborate with DevOps, Software Engineering, Security, and Architecture teams. Implement platform security best practices, access controls, and governance policies. Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, deployment, and platform-related issues. Optimize infrastructure costs and resource utilization. Establish platform engineering standards, documentation, and operational best practices. Job Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 3–7 years of experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or a similar role. Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerization technologies such as Docker. Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. Strong knowledge of Infrastructure as Code tools, including Terraform, Ansible, or Pulumi. Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps. Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Bash, or Go. Experience with configuration management and infrastructure automation. Knowledge of monitoring and observability tools such as: Prometheus Grafana ELK Stack OpenTelemetry Datadog Understanding of networking concepts, Linux administration, security, and distributed systems. Familiarity with microservices architecture and cloud-native technologies. Experience with Git and version control systems. Preferred Qualifications Experience building and managing Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs). Familiarity with platform engineering frameworks and tools such as: Backstage Crossplane ArgoCD FluxCD Helm Istio Experience with service mesh technologies and Kubernetes operators. Knowledge of DevSecOps practices and cloud security. Experience working in large-scale enterprise or multi-cloud environments. Relevant certifications such as: Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA). Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD). AWS Certified Solutions Architect. Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate. HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate.

f7b875c357bf3d08.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة بيت العرب الحديثة عن مدير خدمات لوجستية للانضمام إلى فريقها في نجران. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية الإشراف على الأنشطة اللوجستية والتوزيع اليومية، بالإضافة إلى ضمان كفاءة العمليات التشغيلية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة وتوجيه الأنشطة اليومية للخدمات اللوجستية والتوزيع. الإشراف على أنشطة الصيانة وتنسيق إصلاح المعدات لتقليل زمن التعطل عن العمل. وضع السياسات والإجراءات المتعلقة بالصحة والسلامة والبيئة، ومباشرة تنفيذها لضمان الامتثال للوائح. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الخدمات اللوجستية أو إدارة العمليات. فهم قوي لمبادئ إدارة سلسلة التوريد والعمليات اللوجستية. القدرة على وضع وتنفيذ السياسات والإجراءات التشغيلية. نوع العمل والموقع هذا الدور هو وظيفة دوام كامل ومقرها في نجران. يتطلب التواجد في الموقع لإدارة العمليات اليومية بكفاءة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادية وإدارية قوية. القدرة على حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرارات. مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتنسيق مع الفرق المختلفة. الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم.

f7e05186f0698ab5.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المطورون المتقدمة للصيانة عن مهندس الصحة والسلامة والبيئة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على دراسة وتطوير معايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة للمشاريع الهندسية، بالإضافة إلى مراقبة وتحليل عملية التنفيذ لضمان الالتزام بأعلى المعايير. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية التصميم الكلية للمشاريع، وتقديم المشورة المتخصصة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة البيئية. الإشراف المباشر على أعمال صيانة المعدات وتصليحها بهدف تقليل العادم والمخلفات، والتأكد من سير العمليات وفقاً لمعايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعتمدة. مراقبة العمليات وإجراء جولات تفتيشية منتظمة لمواقع التشغيل والعمليات، لضمان اتباع معايير سلامة البيئة وتقديم النصح والمشورة اللازمة في هذا الشأن. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر، ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في مجال الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب التقدم المحرزة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بالشركة بما يتوافق مع السياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الصحة والسلامة والبيئة أو مجال ذي صلة. فهم جيد لمعايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة الخاصة بالمشاريع الهندسية. القدرة على تحليل البيانات وتقديم توصيات فعالة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة، شفهياً وكتابياً. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وفي بيئات متعددة. مهارات تنظيمية وإدارة الوقت. القدرة على حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرارات. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية. ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحقيق أعلى معايير السلامة والجودة البيئية في جميع المشاريع. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

f7fbf541e6813e7c.description: About the Role Alfalak Electronic Equipment & Supplies Co. is seeking an experienced Liaisonman to join their team in Dhahran, Eastern region. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of relevant experience and involves acting as the primary liaison between the operator and the rig contractor, supervising well operations, and providing training and mentorship to rig personnel and trainees. Key Responsibilities Supervise well operations and ensure contractors adhere to contract requirements. Verify and approve tour reports and field tickets. Monitor rig and equipment maintenance to minimize operational downtime. Enforce Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) standards and ensure compliance with client and industry regulations. Deliver On-the-Job Training (OJT), mentorship, and competency assessments for rig hands and trainees. Prepare and conduct training courses, including specialized topics such as stuck pipe and fishing operations. Diagnose stuck pipe and fishing problems and recommend effective solutions. Qualifications and Experience Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field. Rig experience in a supervisory capacity, such as Toolpusher, Drilling Foreman, or Rig Superintendent. Valid well control certification (IWCF or IADC WellSharp, Supervisor level). Valid H2S, first aid, and other required safety certifications. Demonstrated experience in stuck pipe and fishing operations. Experience in training and assessment; "Train the Trainer" certification is an advantage. Strong English communication skills. Previous experience with major national oil companies is an advantage. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dhahran, within the Eastern region. f7593995250727f4.description: About the Role Larsen & Toubro is seeking a Manager – Power Plant Control System (PPC) Specialist to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for the configuration, testing, commissioning, and validation of central plant control systems. The specialist will ensure the coordinated operation of all generation and compensation assets, maintaining full compliance with grid codes, dispatch instructions, and utility requirements. This position acts as the final functional integrator of the plant. Key Responsibilities Review PPC control philosophy and functional design documents, validating compliance with CEA / POSOCO / local grid codes (*, KSA, CEA, DEWA, EWEC) and utility dispatch/AGC requirements. Review signal lists, data mapping, and control hierarchies, suggesting modifications to PPC control architecture to ensure grid code compliance and avoid latency delays. Coordinate Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) for PPC logic and interfaces. Configure PPC setpoints, control modes, and priorities, integrating PPC with solar inverters, WTGs, BESS & STATCOM, and substation protection/metering. Ensure data integrity from field to PPC and SCADA. Perform open-loop and closed-loop control testing, verifying active power control (APC), reactive power/voltage control (RPC), ramp rate/power gradient control, curtailment, and dispatch commands. Validate loss of communication and fallback modes. Support AGC testing with grid operators and conduct grid compliance tests, including frequency response, voltage control at PCC, and dynamic behavior under contingency events. Support grid audits, mock runs, and final sign-off. Prepare detailed commissioning test reports, upload final configuration backups and change records, and provide training to O&M and control room teams. Support early operational performance stabilization. Testing and Commissioning The specialist will be responsible for testing and commissioning plant-level control systems, ensuring coordinated operation compliant with IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61131-3, IEC 61970/61968, IEC 62351, and other relevant standards. Signal accuracy and latency validation. Control loop stability and response tests. PPC-SCADA-EMS communication verification. Redundancy and failover testing. Troubleshooting Scope Address power mismatch between plant output and PPC dispatch. Resolve oscillatory or unstable control behavior. Investigate communication delays or data loss. Correct incorrect allocation of generation among assets. Manage non-compliance during grid events. Identify and implement corrections in control logics to prevent plant oscillations. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in power plant control systems. Location This position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

f7e38d8365e88694.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة شبه الجزيرة للمقاولات عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة المواقع الإنشائية، وإعداد التصاميم والمخططات، والإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات والمعايير الهندسية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي وتحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع بشكل دقيق. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد تصاميم المشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية. الإشراف المباشر على تنفيذ المشروع ومطابقة المواصفات الفنية والهندسية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة المدنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسبة تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات درجة البكالوريوس في الهندسة المدنية أو ما يعادلها. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة المدنية والمشاريع الإنشائية. معرفة قوية بأسس التصميم الإنشائي وتحليل التربة. القدرة على قراءة وتدقيق المخططات الهندسية وجداول الكميات. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في الإشراف الميداني وإدارة المشاريع. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. مهارات تواصل فعالة والقدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة في العمل. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع والإشراف المباشر على المشاريع. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهندسين المدنيين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذه الفرصة للتقدم بطلباتهم.

Driven by our “Smart Club” concept, we provide a seamless, technology-enabled fitness experience that redefines how members engage with health, wellness, and performance. Key Responsibilities: · Oversee daily club operations, including opening and closing, and facility maintenance. · Maintain a clean, safe, and well-functioning club environment to support a smooth member experience. · Develop and support initiatives that improve member engagement, satisfaction, and retention. · Promote membership sales, strengthen community relationships, and increase awareness of the club. · Train and develop the team to improve service quality and support member satisfaction. · Keep management skills and industry knowledge up to date. · Work collaboratively with the team and assist with other duties as needed. Core Competencies: · Time Management Skills · Team Management knowledge · Communication & Relationship Skills · Sound Analytical Thinking · Strong problem-solving skills · Professionalism and Ethics

f7014c6a6c77b25f.description: About Shory Shory is a digital platform that leverages technology to redefine the insurance experience. The company focuses on simplifying complex insurance processes to provide user-friendly access to coverage. Shory operates as part of First Tech, a technology company specializing in building and scaling digital platforms across financial services and other sectors. Founded in the UAE in 2021, Shory aims to deliver transparent and customer-centric insurance solutions. The Role of Business Analyst Shory is seeking a Business Analyst to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves bridging business needs with technology solutions by analyzing requirements, optimizing processes, and translating strategic objectives into scalable digital solutions. The Business Analyst will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure clear requirements, effective stakeholder alignment, and successful execution throughout the product development lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Partner with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, validate, and document business, functional, and technical requirements. Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and feasibility studies to identify business opportunities. Translate business requirements into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional specifications for development teams. Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineers, UX/UI Designers, and QA teams throughout the product lifecycle. Analyze existing business processes to identify opportunities for automation and optimization. Evaluate operational, financial, and technology-related risks, providing mitigation recommendations. Support the creation of wireframes, prototypes, and workflow documentation to communicate requirements. Produce and maintain key project documentation, including BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and UAT plans. Support project planning by tracking milestones, maintaining issue logs, and monitoring project progress. Facilitate workshops and requirements gathering sessions to align business objectives with technical solutions. Collaborate with QA teams during testing cycles and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT). Monitor product performance post-implementation, gather user feedback, and recommend enhancements. Identify and escalate project risks, issues, and dependencies. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. 3–6 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or in a similar role within a technology or digital transformation environment. Strong understanding of Agile and Scrum methodologies and the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Proven experience gathering, documenting, and translating business requirements into functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Experience creating business documentation, process flows, use cases, wireframes, and workflow diagrams. Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including Product, Engineering, UX/UI, QA, and business stakeholders. Knowledge of business process modelling methodologies such as BPMN or UML is an advantage. Experience using tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Visio, Figma, Miro, or Lucidchart. Required Skills Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across all levels of the business. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic is an advantage. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a high standard of quality and accuracy. Application Information This is a full-time position for a Business Analyst based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The salary for this role will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

f71d3fe8cadf8623.description: About Systra Systra is a global engineering and consultancy group specializing in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, Systra designs safe and sustainable transport solutions to connect people and facilitate access to employment, education, and leisure worldwide. For 65 years, the Group has supported cities and regions in developing, improving, and modernizing their infrastructure and transport systems across the entire project lifecycle, from design to testing, deployment, and maintenance. Operating in over 80 countries, Systra generates 74% of its turnover internationally and supports clients in their digital, ecological, and energy transitions. The Role of Contract Manager Systra is seeking an experienced Contract Manager (Arabic Speaker) to join a Project Management Consultancy (PMC) team in Medina, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves leading contract administration and commercial management for complex construction and infrastructure projects. The successful candidate will ensure compliance with contract terms, manage risks and claims, and support the timely delivery of project objectives. Key Responsibilities Administer and manage construction and consultancy contracts on behalf of the PMC and client. Interpret and apply FIDIC conditions of contract, including contract amendments and project-specific requirements. Advise project leadership on contractual obligations, risks, entitlements, and mitigation measures. Manage variations, extensions of time, claims, notices, payments, and change control processes. Review contractor and consultant submissions, correspondence, progress reports, and payment applications. Support the preparation and negotiation of contractual correspondence and commercial recommendations. Monitor compliance with contract procedures, milestones, deliverables, and record-keeping requirements. Identify and manage contractual risks, disputes, and potential claims; support dispute avoidance and resolution. Coordinate with the client, contractors, consultants, and internal project teams on contract matters. Maintain accurate contract registers, records, and reports. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 15 years of experience in contract management, preferably within a PMC environment. Demonstrated expertise in administering complex construction and infrastructure contracts. Proficiency in interpreting and applying FIDIC conditions of contract. Strong understanding of contractual obligations, risk management, and claims processes. Fluency in Arabic is required for this role. Work Location This position is based in Medina, Saudi Arabia.

f786ded2a46c4839.description: About the Role Plaza Premium Group is seeking a Guest Services Associate to deliver professional guest services in airport lounges across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is based in Yanbu, Al Madinah, and focuses on ensuring a positive guest experience in line with company standards and admission procedures. The role involves supporting lounge operations through accurate handling of guest records, cash transactions, and operational checks. Key Responsibilities Handle guest check-in procedures and ensure compliance with lounge admission guidelines. Greet, receive, and bid farewell to guests at lounge entrances and reception areas. Assist guests with internet access, baggage arrangements, shower access, and nap room bookings. Conduct regular checks of all lounge areas and report maintenance or cleaning requirements. Promote lounge services and facilities while professionally handling guest requests and complaints. Manage lost and found items and maintain proper documentation. Handle confidential guest information with a high level of integrity and discretion. Answer incoming telephone calls and take appropriate immediate actions when required. Maintain accurate records of cash flows, receipts, and related documentation. Support the implementation and continuous improvement of quality management systems. Perform any other duties assigned by the Supervisor in line with operational requirements. Required Qualifications and Experience 0-1 year of experience in a relevant customer service role. Presentable, customer-focused, and professional demeanor. Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Ability to work independently and under pressure in a fast-paced environment. Basic cash handling skills and attention to detail. Willingness to work shift duties as required. Work Environment This role operates within airport lounges in Yanbu and Medina, Saudi Arabia, requiring adaptability to a dynamic environment and adherence to operational schedules, including shift duties.

f700aeab82fc9ccd.description: About the Role مدارس المجموعة العالمية (ISG) is seeking a Mathematics Teacher to deliver engaging and inclusive mathematics teaching across KS3, IGCSE, and A-Level. This full-time position is based in the Eastern region of Saudi Arabia, specifically in Al Khobar and Dhahran. The role focuses on developing students' conceptual understanding, fluency, mathematical reasoning, and problem-solving skills, while contributing to the ISG Graduate Profile through classroom practice, pastoral care, and participation in school life. Key Responsibilities Plan, deliver, and document a coherent mathematics curriculum from KS3 through IGCSE to A-Level, ensuring consistent implementation and progression. Apply consistent assessment, moderation, recording, and reporting practices, using evidence to identify learning gaps and monitor progress. Prepare students for internal and external examinations, meeting syllabus and assessment deadlines. Deliver inclusive and appropriately challenging teaching that meets diverse learning needs and develops mathematical understanding, reasoning, problem-solving, and communication. Utilize evidence-informed teaching strategies, purposeful practice, mathematical representations, and digital tools to check understanding and build confidence. Fulfill form tutor responsibilities, supporting student wellbeing, attendance, and academic progress, and communicating effectively with families. Collaborate in departmental planning, meetings, moderation, and professional learning, and contribute to extracurricular activities and school events. Maintain welcoming, organized classrooms and care for departmental resources. Adhere to school health and safety, safeguarding, and child protection procedures, reporting concerns promptly and completing required training. Maintain professional conduct and confidentiality, follow school policies, and engage in ongoing professional development. Qualifications and Knowledge A university degree in Mathematics or a closely related subject is required; a master's degree in mathematics or education is preferred. A recognized teaching qualification (*, PGCE, QTS, or BEd) from a nationally accredited institution. Strong subject knowledge and understanding of curriculum design, assessment, and effective mathematics teaching across KS3, IGCSE, and A-Level/IB. Knowledge of safeguarding, child protection, and student wellbeing in a school environment. Knowledge of the British curriculum and experience teaching across different school phases is preferred. Experience and Skills A minimum of two full school years of successful Mathematics teaching experience is essential. Experience teaching KS3, IGCSE, and A-Level Mathematics, ideally within a British curriculum school, is preferred. Ability to plan inclusive learning for students with varied needs and use assessment evidence to improve learning and student outcomes is essential. Experience with assessment moderation, coaching, or curriculum development is preferred. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with strong interpersonal skills for working with students, parents, and colleagues. Ability to work independently and collaboratively, and to lead an after-school activity is essential. Experience using Google Education tools, form tutoring, or pastoral care is preferred. Demonstrable commitment to safeguarding, student wellbeing, inclusive education, and ISG’s core values, mission, and Graduate Profile. Police clearance demonstrating suitability to work with children in a school environment. Commitment to ongoing professional development. Work Environment The Mathematics Teacher will operate within the dynamic educational environment of مدارس المجموعة العالمية (ISG) in Al Khobar and Dhahran. The role requires a commitment to fostering an inclusive classroom culture that promotes respect, reflection, resilience, and learning from mistakes, aligning with ISG’s core values of Respect, Acceptance, Integrity, and Responsibility.

f7368c5a9374f51e.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركه منبع التصافي عن كهربائي مباني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية تركيب وصيانة وتصليح الأسلاك الكهربائية والأجهزة والتجهيزات ضمن المباني والهياكل المختلفة. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب المعدات الكهربائية في المباني، بما في ذلك الكابلات والأسلاك والأجهزة الأخرى. إجراء عمليات التفتيش الروتينية كجزء من الصيانة الوقائية لتحديد الأضرار التي قد تلحق بالمعدات. تصليح واستبدال المعدات الكهربائية مثل الكابلات والأسلاك والأجهزة عند الضرورة. استخدام مجموعة متنوعة من الأدوات اليدوية والمعدات الأساسية لإنجاز المهام المطلوبة. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال كهرباء المباني. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الكهربائية. معرفة قوية بأنظمة الأسلاك الكهربائية والأجهزة والتجهيزات. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات فنية ممتازة في تركيب وصيانة الأنظمة الكهربائية. القدرة على استخدام الأدوات والمعدات الكهربائية بأمان وفعالية. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة المهنية. مهارات حل المشكلات لتحديد الأعطال الكهربائية وإصلاحها. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الفرصة في مدينة الرياض، وتتطلب التزامًا بالعمل بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركه منبع التصافي. سيتم العمل في بيئة تتطلب الدقة والالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم مع الأخذ في الاعتبار المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه. سيتم مراجعة جميع الطلبات بعناية.

f7537a1f850cbb3d.description: About the Role Duncan & Ross is seeking a Tender & Estimation Engineer to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role is responsible for overseeing the complete tendering and cost estimation process for restoration projects. The position ensures that all tender documents are clear and comprehensive, cost estimates are reliable, and bid evaluations are conducted fairly, transparently, and are defensible for procurement and audit review. Key Responsibilities Prepare tender documents, including the scope of work, technical requirements, bills of quantities, evaluation criteria, and commercial terms. Develop cost estimates and budgets for each work package. Consolidate technical input from discipline engineers into comprehensive tender documents. Coordinate site visits for bidders, respond to bidder clarifications, and issue necessary addenda and extensions. Maintain tender schedules and records in compliance with company procurement policy. Conduct technical and commercial evaluations, benchmarking bid prices against the established cost estimate. Prepare bid comparison statements and recommendations for award. Support the purchase requisition, purchase order, and contract award processes. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, focusing on critical restoration works. The role requires close coordination with various internal teams, including discipline engineers, and external bidders to ensure efficient and compliant tendering processes.

f78cab4327d71dd4.description: About the Role Amazon Saudi Arabia is seeking an Inbound Placement Program Manager to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role is crucial for ensuring end-to-end launch readiness across all Fulfillment Centers (FCs) and Stores within the Core, Rush, and Now networks. The position involves leading configuration design, planning, and execution readiness for new nodes, ensuring operational scalability and compliance with Amazon standards. Role Context and Impact The Inbound Placement Program Manager will collaborate closely with Operations, Supply Chain, Tech, and Business teams to define launch scope and validate configuration inputs, including inbound, outbound, and storage topology. This role manages readiness checkpoints from the planning phase through Go-Live, standardizing launch mechanisms, and ensuring alignment with Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP), topology, and capacity plans. The incumbent will serve as the single-threaded owner for configuration health across multiple speed networks, requiring a deep understanding of fulfillment network design, operational processes, and cross-functional project management. Key Responsibilities Lead end-to-end configuration readiness for all new FCs, SDCs, IXDs, and stores across Core, Rush, and Now networks. Define and track readiness milestones, including inbound, storage, outbound, systems, and capacity, from planning through Go-Live. Partner with Operations, Supply Chain, and Business teams to validate launch inputs, volume ramp plans, and operational dependencies. Translate planning inputs into executable operational readiness milestones. Standardize launch mechanisms and ensure alignment with S&OP, topology, and capacity plans. Required Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated understanding of fulfillment network design and operational processes. Experience in cross-functional project management. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within Amazon's dynamic and evolving fulfillment network. The role requires collaboration with various internal teams to achieve operational excellence and launch readiness. Application Process Candidates interested in this role are encouraged to apply through the official Amazon Saudi Arabia career portal.

f7a0ac5d0ea1bd9b.description: We are seeking a proactive, highly organized, and results-driven Administrative & Operations Manager to oversee daily administrative and operational activities within a school environment. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong leadership, exceptional communication skills, and a high level of ownership and initiative. This role requires a hands-on professional with a project management mindset who can independently coordinate school operations, anticipate operational needs, resolve challenges, and implement improvements to ensure a well-organized, efficient, and high-quality educational environment. Oversee daily school administrative activities, ensuring efficiency, organization, and adherence to established policies and procedures. Supervise administrative staff, delegate responsibilities, monitor performance, and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks. Ensure classrooms, meeting rooms, and school facilities are properly prepared, organized, and equipped to support daily activities. Act as a key point of coordination between school management, teachers, administrative staff, and external stakeholders. Monitor administrative schedules, resource requirements, supplies, and facility-related needs. Proactively identify administrative challenges, take ownership of resolving issues, and implement effective solutions. Plan and coordinate school events, meetings, activities, and administrative initiatives. Establish and maintain professional relationships with external organizations, suppliers, service providers, and strategic partners. Identify and implement improvements to administrative procedures, workflows, and overall organizational efficiency. Maintain accurate administrative records, documentation, and reports while providing management with regular updates and recommendations. Ensure professional communication and a positive experience for parents, visitors, employees, and other stakeholders. Coordinate administrative projects and initiatives, ensuring effective planning, execution, and follow-up. Minimum 3–5 years of experience in administration, administrative management, or team supervision. Proven experience supervising administrative teams and managing multiple responsibilities. Excellent proficiency in both English and Arabic, written and spoken, is mandatory. Strong leadership, communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills. Excellent problem-solving, decision-making, and multitasking abilities. Strong coordination and stakeholder relationship management skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and administrative management systems. Experience coordinating school events, administrative projects, and external partnerships.

f7bddbc2dacc419a.description: About the Role Le Méridien Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Restaurant Manager I to oversee daily restaurant operations in Makkah. This full-time role involves supervising staff, maintaining service and sanitation standards, and ensuring exceptional guest experiences. The manager will contribute to menu planning and support the team during peak service periods, focusing on continuous improvement in guest and employee satisfaction, and maximizing financial performance. Key Responsibilities Supervise and manage all day-to-day restaurant, bar/lounge, and room service operations, ensuring adherence to service and sanitation standards. Review staffing levels to meet guest service, operational needs, and financial objectives. Lead and influence the food and beverage team, fostering mutual trust, respect, and cooperation. Identify developmental needs of employees and provide coaching, mentoring, and training to enhance their skills. Ensure compliance with all food & beverage policies, standards, procedures, and applicable laws and regulations, including food handling and liquor laws. Establish and maintain collaborative relationships with employees, setting clear expectations and parameters. Ensuring Exceptional Guest Service Provide services that exceed customer expectations for satisfaction and retention. Act as a role model for guest hospitality, demonstrating excellent customer service and creating a positive atmosphere. Manage daily operations to ensure quality and standards meet customer expectations. Handle guest problems and complaints effectively and ensure corrective actions are taken to improve service results. Gather feedback from guests informally during meals or upon departure to assess satisfaction with food, beverage, and service levels. Identify educational needs, develop formal training programs, and instruct employees. Ensure fair and equitable treatment of employees and strive to improve employee retention. Solicit employee feedback through an "open door" policy and review satisfaction results to address concerns. Ensure ongoing training for employees to understand guest expectations and improve service performance. This role involves assisting servers and hosts on the floor during peak meal periods and high-demand times, recognizing good quality products and presentations, and overseeing daily shift operations in the absence of an Assistant Restaurant Manager.

f7e81cc7ec3cbddc.description: About the Role Ninja (quick-commerce) is seeking a Real Estate Performance Analyst to join its Real Estate Management team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This full-time role is designed for a detail-oriented and analytical professional with 2-5 years of experience, responsible for monitoring the performance of real estate units and supporting data-driven decision-making. Role Overview The Real Estate Performance Analyst will focus on analyzing results against targets, preparing comprehensive reports and dashboards, and identifying performance gaps. The role involves tracking key performance indicators (KPIs) and recommending improvements to enhance overall efficiency within the real estate operations. Experience in developing KPI dashboards; Power BI or similar tools is an advantage. Experience in real estate, retail expansion, or operations is an advantage. Ability to work independently and present findings objectively. Strong written and verbal communication skills in both Arabic and English. f72dfee1e0d461ed.description: نبذة عن الدور يقدم مصرف الراجحي فرصة وظيفية لاستشاري مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقه في المنطقة الشرقية بالمملكة العربية السعودية. يشمل هذا الدور، الذي يتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، العمل بدوام كامل في مدن مثل الدمام، الخبر، الظهران، الجبيل، الأحساء، القطيف، بقيق، راس تنورة، صفوى، الجش، عنك، دارين، العمران، المبرز، والجفر. يركز الدور على تقديم المنتجات والخدمات المصرفية للعملاء بمستوى عالٍ من الجودة والاحترافية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى استشاري المبيعات مجموعة من المهام الأساسية التي تضمن سير العمليات المصرفية بسلاسة وفعالية، مع التركيز على خدمة العملاء f7434243f6444106.description: الغرض من الوظيفة  المحافظة على أمن وسالمة المنشأة وممتلكاتها والعاملين والزوار، ومراقبة الدخول والخروج، والابلاغ عن أي ملاحظات أو مخالفات أو حالات طارئة. المهام والمسئوليات المهام والمسئوليات الرئيسية: مراقبة مداخل ومخارج المنشأة والتأكد من تنظيم حركة الدخول والخروج . التأكد من هوية الزوار وتسجيل بياناتهم حسب الاجراءات المعتمدة . القيام بجولات تفقدية دورية داخل الموقع للتأكد من السالمة والامن . متابعة كاميرات المراقبة والابلاغ عن أي سلوك أو حدث غير اعتيادي . حماية ممتلكات الشركة والحد من أي محاولات سرقة أو تخريب . التعامل مع الحالات الطارئة وفق التعليمات والاجراءات المعتمدة . الابلاغ الفوري عن الحوادث أو الاعطال أو المخالفات الامنيه . التأكد من اغلاق الابواب والمرافق بعد انتهاء ساعات العمل . التعاون مع الجهات المختصة عند الحاجة . الاتزام بالزي الرسمي والتعليمات والسياسات الداخلية للمنشأة. الكفاءات والمهارات المؤهلات العلمية: شهادة الثانوية العامة أو ما يعادلها . الخبرات العملية: يفضل وجود خبرة سابقة في مجال الحراسة أو الامن . الالمام بأساسيات الامن والسلامه التوصيف الوظيفي المهارات المطلوبة الانضباط وتحمل المسؤولية . القدرة على الملاحظه والانتباه للتفاصيل . حسن التعامل مع الاخرين . القدرة على التصرف السريع في الحالات الطارئة . اللياقة البدنية المناسبة للعمل. المهارات التواصلية  مهارات ممتازة في القيادة والتوجيه والتواصل الفعّال.

f7b7cbfb8851db0f.description: Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Site MEP Engineer to oversee and coordinate all Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) works throughout the construction lifecycle. The successful candidate will ensure that all MEP installations are executed in accordance with approved drawings, project specifications, applicable codes, quality standards, and project schedules while coordinating with consultants, contractors, and multidisciplinary teams. Key Responsibilities Supervise and monitor all MEP works on-site to ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications, and contract requirements. Review MEP shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, and technical documentation. Coordinate MEP activities with civil, structural, architectural, and other project disciplines to prevent clashes and ensure smooth project execution. Conduct regular site inspections to verify installation quality, workmanship, and compliance with project standards. Monitor contractor performance and ensure MEP works are completed according to project schedules and milestones. Resolve technical issues and provide engineering solutions to maintain project progress. Ensure compliance with local regulations, international codes, health and safety requirements, and QA/QC procedures. Review and witness testing, commissioning, and functional performance of MEP systems. Prepare and review inspection requests (IRs), testing reports, snag lists, punch lists, and close-out documentation. Participate in coordination meetings and provide technical support, progress reports, and recommendations. Review as-built drawings and verify completed installations prior to project handover. Evaluate technical variations, change orders, and site modifications when required. Maintain accurate documentation of inspections, approvals, testing records, and site activities. Support the successful commissioning and handover of all MEP systems. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or MEP Engineering. Minimum 10+ years of experience in supervising MEP works on construction projects. Experience in commercial, residential, industrial, or infrastructure projects. Strong knowledge of HVAC, plumbing, fire protection, electrical power, lighting, low-current systems, and building services. Familiarity with local and international building codes, MEP standards, and engineering best practices. Professional engineering registration or relevant accreditation is preferred. Technical Skills Proficiency in AutoCAD , Revit MEP , Navisworks , and Microsoft Office . Ability to review coordinated MEP drawings, BIM models, shop drawings, and technical submittals. Knowledge of testing, commissioning, QA/QC procedures, and inspection processes. Experience with project management and document control software is an advantage. Core Competencies Strong MEP coordination and site management skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management. Strong technical and analytical problem-solving abilities. Leadership and multidisciplinary team coordination. Attention to detail and commitment to quality. Time management and ability to work under pressure. Strong reporting, documentation, and organizational skills.

f705c8fa9319a701.company_name: شركة تنمية الإنسان | Human Development Company
f705c8fa9319a701.description: استقبال الزوار والعملاء والرد على الاتصالات الهاتفية وتنظيم المواعيد وتقديم الدعم الإداري، بما يضمن حسن سير العمل وتولد انطباع مهني إيجابي عن المركز. المهام والمسئوليات: المهام والمسئوليات الرئيسية: استقبال الزوار والترحيب بهم بما يليق بالمظهر العام للمركز. مسؤولية أبواب المركز من خلال فتحها وإقفالها طوال وقت العمل. تسجيل واستلام الأطفال من أولياء الأمور أثناء خروج ودخول المستفيدين. حسن التصرف في المواقف الطارئة. الاستماع بعناية للزوار لضمان تقديم الخدمة المناسبة. التقيد بالزي الرسمي. الالتزام بسرية المعلومات وحمايتها من أي تسريب. تسويق الخدمات للعملاء. خدمة العملاء وأمين الصندوق: متابعة عملية التمويل للعملاء و التوثيق في النماذج المخصصة. التواصل وتأكيد حجز المواعيد. تحديث بيانات العملاء الزائرين في النماذج المخصصة. التنسيق مع الأقسام الإدارية الأخرى في الفرع. متابعة رضا العملاء. متابعة عملاء التأمين وتزويدهم بالإفادات. متابعة حضور العملاء وعدد الجلسات وتوقيع النماذج المعتمدة. إدخال اسم العميل للجلسات التعويضية على نظام زيبرا بوكس. حصر الفواتير على سدايا. متابعة إجراءات الدفع مع الأهل على نظام وتطبيقات الدفع والفواتير الكترونياً و يدوياً. التسجيل في كشف الخصومات للفرع. متابعة تسوية العهدة كل يوم 15 من كل شهر وترتيب ملف الفواتير. عمل مراجعة ورفع أموال لمحاسب الفرع. أي مهام أخرى توكل إليها من قبل الرئيس المباشر أو مهام تقتضيها حاجة العمل. الكفاءات والمهارات: المؤهلات العلمية: شهادة الثانوية العامة كحد أدنى، ويفضل دبلوم إداري أو ما يعادله. المهارات الشخصية: مهارات التواصل وخدمة العملاء. اللباقة وحسن التعامل. التنظيم والدقة في العمل. القدرة على multitasking وإدارة عدة مهام. سرعة الاستجابة وحل المشكلات البسيطة. الخبرات العملية: خبرة سابقة في مجال الاستقبال أو خدمة العملاء (يفضل). المهارات التواصلية: مهارات ممتازة في القيادة والتوجيه والتواصل الفعال. إجادة استخدام الحاسب الآلي وبرامج Microsoft Office. مهارات تواصل ممتازة وحسن المظهر والسلوك المهني. القدرة على تنظيم الوقت والعمل تحت الضغط.

f707634af097ba5b.description: Eram Talent is seeking an experienced Scaffolding Supervisor to oversee the safe erection, modification, inspection, and dismantling of scaffolding systems across industrial and construction projects. Reporting to the Site Manager, the role is responsible for supervising scaffolding crews, ensuring compliance with safety regulations and project specifications, and maintaining high standards of quality and productivity. The successful candidate must hold a valid Saudi Aramco Scaffolding Supervisor Card and have proven experience working on Saudi Aramco projects. The ideal candidate is locally available in Saudi Arabia and possesses strong leadership and communication skills. Key Responsibilities Supervise scaffold erection, modification, inspection, and dismantling activities in accordance with project requirements. Ensure all scaffolding work complies with Saudi Aramco standards, company procedures, and HSE regulations. Coordinate daily activities of scaffolding crews to ensure safe and efficient work execution. Conduct routine inspections of scaffolding structures and ensure they are safe for use. Verify scaffold tags, permits, and inspection records are maintained accurately. Ensure proper use of scaffolding materials, tools, and equipment. Identify and mitigate potential safety hazards related to scaffolding operations. Coordinate with construction, maintenance, and HSE teams to support project schedules. Conduct toolbox talks and promote a strong safety culture among workers. Monitor workforce productivity and ensure work is completed within project timelines. Maintain accurate reports, inspection records, and daily progress documentation. Liaise with clients, site management, and inspectors regarding scaffolding activities and compliance. Qualifications & Requirements Diploma, Technical Certificate, or equivalent qualification. Proven experience as a Scaffolding Supervisor on industrial or construction projects. Valid Saudi Aramco Scaffolding Supervisor Card is mandatory. Strong knowledge of scaffolding standards, erection procedures, inspection, and safety practices. Familiarity with Saudi Aramco HSE requirements and permit-to-work systems. Excellent leadership, communication, and team management skills. Ability to read scaffolding drawings and project specifications. Candidates currently residing in Saudi Arabia will be preferred.

These opportunities suit professionals ready to lead initiatives, influence senior stakeholders, and progress toward leadership pathways such as Head of Sales, Head of Marketing, Sales Director, Marketing Director, or Commercial Director (depending on specialism and scope). Key Responsibilities Develop and execute sales and/or marketing strategies aligned to revenue growth, pipeline targets, market share, and brand objectives Own go-to-market planning, including positioning, messaging, segmentation, channel strategy, and integrated campaign delivery Drive new business development and account growth through structured prospecting, relationship management, and account planning (role-dependent) Manage key customer relationships to support retention, renewals, upsell, and cross-sell outcomes Plan, deliver, and optimise multi-channel campaigns (paid, organic, email, content, events, partnerships), tracking ROI and conversion performance Maintain accurate forecasting, reporting, and performance dashboards to guide prioritisation and decision-making Partner with product, operations, finance, and customer teams to improve customer experience and commercial outcomes Create or improve processes, playbooks, and KPI frameworks to enable scalable growth Coach and mentor team members; support onboarding and performance development where applicable Maintain compliant marketing and data-handling practices aligned with applicable Saudi requirements (e.g., PDPL obligations where relevant to the role) Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Economics, or a related field (MBA and relevant certifications are advantageous) 5–12+ years of progressive experience across sales, marketing, or broader commercial roles (mid–senior level) Proven track record delivering measurable outcomes (e.g., revenue growth, pipeline contribution, customer acquisition, conversion improvement, retention) Working knowledge of common commercial systems (depending on specialism), such as: CRM: Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics Marketing automation: HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot, Eloqua Analytics/reporting: GA4, Looker Studio, Tableau, Power BI Ad platforms: Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads (role-dependent) Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including presenting recommendations and performance updates to senior leadership Commercial and analytical capability to interpret data, build business cases, and prioritise activity for impact Employment terms are governed by contract and applicable Saudi labour regulations; some roles may also be subject to localisation requirements (Saudisation/Nitaqat) depending on employer and role type Private Health Insurance Pension Plan Paid Time Off Training & Development

f70c25f945f6073f.description: Hire Resolve is partnering with leading organisations across the Saudi Arabia to recruit experienced mid-senior to senior-level engineering professionals . These roles are well suited to engineers with strong technical expertise, proven project delivery experience, and the ability to operate within large-scale, regulated, and fast-paced environments. This opportunity is designed to encapsulate multiple engineering disciplines and may suit professionals with backgrounds in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Chemical, Industrial, Process, Manufacturing, or Project Engineering , particularly within construction, infrastructure, energy, oil & gas, utilities, and industrial sectors. Key Responsibilities Lead or contribute to engineering projects from concept and design through to execution and commissioning Apply advanced engineering principles to resolve complex technical, operational, and project-related challenges Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including project managers, consultants, contractors, and clients Ensure compliance with Saudi regulations, international codes, and health, safety, and environmental requirements Review and approve engineering drawings, calculations, specifications, and technical documentation Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance quality, efficiency, and project performance Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to junior engineers and technical staff Support project planning, scheduling, budgeting, and risk management activities Liaise with suppliers, vendors, and regulatory authorities as required Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Chemical, Industrial, or related discipline) 7–15+ years of relevant engineering experience , depending on discipline and project scope Proven experience working on complex engineering projects within construction, infrastructure, energy, industrial, or oil & gas environments Strong technical expertise within your engineering discipline Familiarity with Saudi standards, international codes, and industry regulations Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (Arabic is advantageous) Ability to work independently and within multicultural, cross-functional teams Professional Engineer registration or equivalent certification is advantageous (role-dependent) Proficiency with relevant engineering software and tools Private Health Insurance Pension Plan Paid Time Off Training & Development

f706b4352a6d83c2.description: مطلوب محاسب زبائن (كاشير) للعمل في مجال خدمة العملاء والمبيعات. المهام تتضمن: استقبال المدفوعات النقدية والإلكترونية، تسجيل المبيعات في نظام نقاط البيع، تقديم خدمة عملاء متميزة، وإعداد تقارير المبيعات اليومية. يشترط الدقة في التعامل مع الأموال، مهارات تواصل ممتازة، وخبرة سابقة في مجال المحاسبة أو المبيعات.

f73b03cda1e00e01.description: Eram Talent is looking for a dedicated Liaisonman for Offshore operations to be a part of our esteemed client's team. The Liaisonman acts as the primary interface between the Operator’s drilling/workover team, the drilling contractor, and third-party service providers to ensure smooth coordination and execution of offshore drilling and workover operations. The role ensures all operations are conducted safely, efficiently, and in compliance with company and regulatory standards. Responsibilities Serve as the focal point between the Operator and Drilling Contractor during offshore operations. Coordinate day-to-day drilling and workover activities to ensure alignment with operational programs and schedules. Supervise and monitor drilling, completion, and workover operations to ensure adherence to the approved work program. Ensure that safety, environmental, and operational procedures are strictly followed at all times. Communicate operational updates, challenges, and performance reports to the onshore drilling management team. Verify and endorse contractor and third-party service company daily reports, job tickets, and timesheets. Participate in daily operations meetings and contribute to planning and problem-solving discussions. Ensure the availability and readiness of equipment, materials, and personnel for planned operations. Support incident investigations and recommend corrective actions. Liaise with logistics, marine, and procurement teams for the timely mobilization/demobilization of personnel and equipment. Minimum of 5 years of experience in offshore operations or liaison roles. Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Petroleum Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field. Minimum 8 years of oilfield experience , including: Drilling projects (jack-up / semi-sub / land rigs) OR Workover operations (completion, intervention, and well servicing). Previous offshore experience with major operators or drilling contractors is mandatory. Strong knowledge of well control, drilling fluids, downhole tools, completions, and well servicing operations. Valid offshore survival and medical certificates (e.g., BOSIET, HUET, OGUK). IWCF / IADC Well Control Certification (Supervisor level preferred). Excellent communication, leadership, and coordination skills. Ability to work under pressure in a multicultural offshore environment. Salary is not a constraint ,company is looking for right candidate .

f7a7b1581e8a7b70.description: The Maintenance Engineer – Biomedical is responsible for ensuring the safe, effective, and reliable maintenance of biomedical and clinical equipment, as well as supporting broader facilities maintenance operations across KAUST’s community infrastructure. This role focuses on auditing, monitoring, and verifying the work of service providers, ensuring full compliance with technical, contractual, and safety standards. The engineer will manage both preventive and corrective maintenance activities and contribute to long-term asset lifecycle management. The position requires technical expertise in biomedical systems, asset performance evaluation, compliance with international and local standards, and effective use of CMMS tools (SAP/Maximo). Ensure effective and safe execution of preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance for biomedical and facility assets. Monitor maintenance activities to ensure alignment with KAUST standards, safety protocols, SOPs, and KPIs. Conduct audits, inspections, and technical reviews to verify service quality and compliance with regulatory standards (JCI, SFDA, CBAHI/SBAHI, IEC, HTM). Support troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and the implementation of corrective and preventive actions. Oversee calibration, maintenance, and performance verification of biomedical equipment in the community medical facility. Maintain accurate asset data in the CMMS (SAP/Maximo) and support lifecycle planning and preventive maintenance strategies. Coordinate with stakeholders and provide regular reports and recommendations to improve service quality and asset reliability. Demonstrate expertise in biomedical equipment calibration, testing, performance verification, and lifecycle management. Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering or related engineering discipline. Minimum 4–6 years of experience in the maintenance and operation of biomedical systems and general facilities equipment. Advanced knowledge of preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance methodologies. Strong understanding of biomedical equipment standards, device safety, and infection control protocols. Proficiency in Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS), preferably SAP or Maximo. Strong technical expertise in biomedical equipment calibration, testing, and lifecycle management. In-depth understanding of international codes and standards related to facilities and medical equipment. Proven track record in contractor management, inspections, audits, and performance monitoring. Hands-on experience in complying with international and local regulations and standards, including: JCI, CBAHI/SBAHI, SFDA, IEC 60601, HTM Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional (CMRP) - Preferred Biomedical Equipment Technician (BMET) certification - Preferred

f7ba97a7ba25c02b.description: Join our dynamic team at Müller's Solutions as an SAP Basis Lead Consultant, where you will play a crucial role in ensuring the optimal performance and stability of our clients' SAP environments. In this position, you will lead a team of SAP Basis consultants, providing strategic guidance and hands-on expertise in managing and supporting complex SAP landscapes. Key Responsibilities: Oversee the installation, configuration, and administration of SAP systems in both development and production environments. Lead performance tuning, optimizations, and capacity planning for SAP databases. Monitor system health and proactively address issues to maintain high availability and reliability. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define requirements and implement effective solutions to meet client needs. Manage upgrades, migrations, and patches for SAP systems, ensuring minimal disruption to operations. Act as a mentor and leader for junior consultants, providing knowledge sharing and professional development opportunities. Maintain comprehensive documentation of system configurations and procedures. Stay informed about the latest SAP technologies and enhancements, evaluating and implementing best practices. Provide on-call support as required for SAP systems. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Minimum of 7 years of experience in SAP Basis administration, with at least 3 years in a lead or senior consultant role. Extensive knowledge of SAP installations, upgrades, and migrations, as well as troubleshooting SAP environments. Familiarity with SAP HANA, S/4HANA, and other cloud-based SAP solutions is preferred. Strong understanding of database management systems (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server) and operating systems (e.g., Linux, Windows). Proven ability to effectively lead and manage teams, fostering a collaborative and positive work environment. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills to address complex technical challenges. Effective communication skills with the ability to work closely with clients and stakeholders. Industry-recognized SAP certifications (e.g., SAP Certified Technology Associate) are highly desirable. Proven track record of delivering successful SAP Basis projects on time and within budget. Why Join Us: Opportunity to work with a talented and passionate team. Competitive salary and benefits package. Exciting projects and innovative work environment.
